main_topics.reason: The user came saying they can't keep working, decided to resign and had the bot write and warm up the resignation letter over several turns.
The user wanted to talk to something that wouldn't sigh at them, spoke of being tired of fighting, teared up at the letter and ended feeling calmer.
The user described mistakes by 11am and two-day crashes, which explain why work is unsustainable.
The user asked for a proper explanation of pacing and said it finally clicked.
The bot explained adjustments and occupational health after the user said HR gave only vague offers, but the user had already decided to resign.
The user mentioned once that HR only said to let them know if anything was needed.
The user asked in one turn what to do for their health after leaving, and the bot suggested a long COVID clinic referral and checking contributors.

output.summary: A user with long COVID said they could no longer keep working because of fatigue, brain fog and post-exertion crashes, and wanted to talk. The bot offered support and information about adjustments and occupational health. When the user decided to resign it drafted and then warmed up a resignation letter, and it explained pacing. The user said they felt calmer and that pacing had finally made sense. No safety-critical moments were identified; the wish to be 'done' was clearly about work and resigning.
